room.hall.title: Stone Hall
room.hall.description: A bare hall of grey stone. A doorway opens east; stairs climb north.
room.dart_room.title: Dart Corridor
room.dart_room.description: A narrow corridor. Small holes line the walls at chest height.
room.shrine.title: Hilltop Shrine
room.shrine.description: A small shrine under the open sky. The air feels light here.
item.antidote.room: A [glass vial] of green liquid rests on the floor.
item.antidote.description: A stoppered vial. The label reads: antidote.
narration.poison.applied: A dart pricks your arm. Cold spreads from the wound.
narration.poison.tick: The poison burns in your veins.
narration.poison.expired: The poison fades from your blood.
narration.eat_antidote: You drink the antidote. The cold drains away.
